prompt.text: Hey, sorry, you're the new hire, right? Elena says the acquisition wire has to go out now, and the approval form's down. She said you could release it. I really don't want to be the one who held this up.

choices.label: Send the wire
choices.bark: The payment leaves. Nobody confirmed it was Elena.
choices.report: You released a payment because a message said to.

choices.label: Call Elena on the number we have
choices.bark: You call the number finance already had. She didn't order a wire.
choices.report: The wire waited until Elena was on a number finance already had.

choices.label: I don't send wires
choices.bark: You don't send it. Maya calls Elena herself.
choices.report: You refused the wire. Maya called Elena herself.
